ABOUT

Chicago-born and raised singer-songwriter Ravyn Lenae first started releasing music in the latter half of the 2010s with a trio of EPs, making the biggest splash with 2018’s Crush EP and its lead single “Sticky.” In 2022, Ravyn released HYPNOS, her critically acclaimed debut via Atlantic Records, with Steve Lacy, Monte Booker, and KAYTRANADA among its producers. 

Her sophomore album, Bird’s Eye, was released in 2024 and garnered praise from numerous publications. Executive produced by Grammy Award-winning producer Dahi (Kendrick Lamar, SZA), Bird’s Eye is nestled within Ravyn’s memories of home, intertwining her vocals with pop, indie, reggae, jazz, and rock. She later made her late-night TV debut on The Tonight Show starring Jimmy Fallon and joined KAYTRANADA and Channel Tres on The Late Show with Stephen Colbert. Bird’s Eye notably features “Love Me Not,” which has garnered over a billion global streams and landed Ravyn her first top 5 appearance on the Billboard Hot 100.

2025 saw Ravyn’s debut performances at Coachella, her hometown’s heralded Lollapalooza festival, Good Morning America, Jimmy Kimmel Live!, and a sold-out four-show residency at the Blue Note Jazz Club. She then launched her sold-out headline North American and UK/EU tours, while also joining Reneé Rapp and Sabrina Carpenter on select dates of their respective arena tours. While 2025 remains a breakthrough year, Ravyn intends for an even bigger 2026 with the release of her third studio album coming soon.

ABOUT

Over the past two years, up-and-coming Frankfurt rapper OG LU has made a name for herself on the German rap scene. With songs such as “Paar Ecken Hish,” “Kein Zurück Freestyle,” and “Sonne Strand Sattla,” she continues to assert herself and captivate fans not only with her dynamic flow and clever lyrics full of wordplay, but also with her charismatic stage presence during live performances. Whether energetic and aggressive or thoughtful and reflective, OG LU always manages to show her personality through her music, addressing empowerment and personal experiences from her life in Frankfurt. With the track “Paar Ecken Hish,” she was able to make her first mark! She takes us with her as she parties through the Frankfurt nights with her girls and tells us exciting stories from the Gallus district.

After SDP celebrate their 25th anniversary in 2024 with a unique open-air summer in the biggest venues in the band's history to date, Vincent and Dag will play selected festivals in 2025 in addition to their big “They just want to play” arena tour.

Ten studio albums, singles that have since gone multi-gold and even multi-platinum, almost a billion views on YouTube, countless headlining slots at all major festivals and an anniversary tour with more than 260,000 visitors: SDP are now without question one of the most successful bands in the country. Their live shows are bursting with energy and spread not only a long-lasting good mood, but also persistent catchy tunes. “Die Bekannteste Unbekannte Band der Welt": a unique independent career for the two Berlin friends, who are no longer so unknown thanks to their participation in Sing meinen Song and the 1LIVE Krone award for best live act.

On October 25, 2024, the “Best Of 25 Years SDP” will be released album, which includes many brand new and previously unreleased songs alongside their greatest hits.

One of the most unique and exciting bass music outfits to emerge in recent times, Koven is the production alias of Writer / Producer Max Rowat and fronted live by Writer / DJ / Vocalist Katie Boyle. Spotted as one of the pioneering artists to back cinematic bass music Koven have been collating millions of online streams as well as a string of high profile music placements in Film / TV / Advertising and Games.

PA69 – pronounced “PA” in English and “69” in German – are a rap group from Berlin. Little to nothing is known about the identities of the three pink-masked rappers DJ DOPE, Rabatto, and Turbogianni. What is certain is that they grew up in the affluent suburbs of Berlin and in rural northeast Germany.

Further rumors regarding the identity of the three members (youth basketball coach, combat diver, Michelin-starred chef, wedding DJ, doctor of law, or freestyle king) and the meaning of the abbreviation PA69 cannot be confirmed with certainty.

PA69 released their first tape, “Tape No. Two,” in 2020. Shortly thereafter, ‘Kingmische’ became their first veritable underground hit. Their first concerts at Goa open-air festivals and in Berlin pub basements were followed by their own tour of sold-out clubs after the release of “Biertornado” in 2023. In their hometown of Berlin, PA69 played to a sold-out crowd at SO36 in early 2024, followed by a sold-out show at Astra Kulturhaus at the end of the year; another concert at Columbiahalle has already been announced. Meanwhile, PA69 are attracting an extremely diverse audience far beyond Berlin's city limits and have played several sold-out tours and at festivals such as Splash!, Fusion, Spektrum, Pangea, and Dockville. In other words, slowly but surely, no one can ignore the PA69 phenomenon anymore.

The fact that the people behind PA69 are so elusive gives the three rappers tremendous freedom to slip effortlessly into a wide variety of roles. Lyrically, they work with anti-styles and obscure references—the more bizarre, the better.

So while other players in the music scene are all about coolness, toughness, and wealth, these rappers make a point of being uncool. PA69 flirts with the very things that others look down on: life in the provinces, fingerboards, fake luxury watches, and supermarket loyalty points. In short, PA69 are masters of “ironic Dadaist distortion” (Alex Barbian).

In their euphoric, slogan-like rap, PA69 also convey an intoxicated, hedonistic attitude to life, which places them in the cosmos of Berlin's “Atzen rap.” The influences of certain rap greats, especially those from Berlin, are unmistakable – one is repeatedly reminded of the K.IZ. promo album, DJ Reckless, Corus86, or the Atzen, Frauenarzt, and Manny Marc. Lyrically, however, PA69 never stoops to low blows. Unlike what is still common in German rap, their punchlines are directed neither at women nor at minorities.

PA69 deliver a special, energetic show live. Always part of the act: an animator in a sun costume, who is both a cheerleader and lead dancer, carefully arranged intros made up of pop culture set pieces, and the now indispensable “beer tornado” circle pit. The quality media have also come to understand that PA69 is something special: For the Berliner Zeitung, the band's “guaranteed never-before-heard, creative rap lines” are “incredibly fun,” even though it is “by no means a pure fun project.” For the Tagesspiegel, the “mood phenomenon PA69” is already one of the most exciting newcomers of 2024.

Symba steht Pashanim in Nichts nach, wenn es um Star-Potenzial geht, schlägt aber völlig andere Töne an. Er pickt Beats, die sogar noch reduzierter klingen und teilweise deutlich verspulter sind als die von seinem Playboysmafia-Kollegen. Zusätzlich setzt Symba seine Stimme einzigartig ein, was in durchgeknallten Adlibs, Gesang und Geräuschen Ausdruck findet.

HBz aka Nils & Niklas have scooped up everything that can be scooped up as a DJ and producer duo in Germany over the past two years. Their remixes and originals have been viewed more than half a billion times on YouTube alone, making them one of the top 10 most listened to YouTube artists in the country. With their unique sound, ranging from bounce to hardstyle, the duo has been on the main stages and on the Airpods of their fans, the #hbzfamily, has become indispensable. Their songs have been streamed over 400 million times on Spotify so far. The single "KINGKONG" was in the German Top100 single charts for half a year in 2021 and has already brought the duo their second gold after their award for the single "DEINE AUGEN". With their remix of TREAM's "Lebenslang" they landed the next brilliant hit, which has already been listened to over 40 million times on Spotify alone. They also cause a stir with official remixes for SDP, VIZE, Finch or Helene Fischer. Their remix of Ricky Martin's "Livin' la vida loca" became a worldwide phenomenon and with songs like "Wolke 10", "High Sein" and "Drop Drop Drop" they have brought new hits to their legendary live performances. HBz meanwhile dismantle entire stadiums; be it in front of 40,000 fans in the Veltins Arena in Gelsenkirchen or at Lollapalooza in the Olympiastadion Berlin, at Parookaville, SputnikSpring Break, SonneMondstern, Spring Break Island, Electrisize, OpenBeatz, but also at their more intimate club shows in the Bootshaus Cologne or in the Neuraum Munich. From their base in Lower Saxony, where they also organize their own festival "Home of Madness", they now travel all over Europe for their live shows. On the wave of success, however, the two remain true to themselves and their love of music. "Connecting emotions and escalation" is not only her motto for her music, which has been heard millions of times, but also on stage.

Every so often an act will emerge in a specific genre and turn it inside out. They’ll pull it, they’ll push it, they’ll make you question everything about it. They’ll bring in their own influences, elements and techniques. They’ll build huge towers then knock them down… Only to build something even bigger, even more influential, timeless and definitive.One particular duo who continue to do this are multiple award winning, Vienna-based duo Camo & Krooked.

Lorde is a Grammy-winning artist and cultural force, known for her genre-defying sound, introspective lyricism, and striking creative vision. Since her breakthrough with Pure Heroine in 2013, she has redefined the contours of modern pop—merging poetic storytelling with minimalist, emotionally resonant production. To date, she has amassed over 18 billion global streams and 18 million album sales worldwide. 

In April 2025, she returned with What Was That, her first original release in four years. The single debuted to widespread acclaim and commercial success, hitting #1 on Spotify in the US — her first US #1 on the platform since “Royals.” It also landed at #3 in the UK and #5 globally, reaffirming her place at the forefront of pop music.

What was initially interpreted as a mysterious art project turned out to be a large-scale campaign by the Chemnitz band Kraftklub: On a Monday at the end of May, a huge sign with the words “Sterben in Karl-Marx-Stadt” (Dying in Karl Marx City) appeared in the Saxon city, initially puzzling onlookers. The countdown on the sign ran down to Wednesday evening at 9:15 p.m. – and then the moment arrived: the band gave a spontaneous concert and opened with their brand-new single “Schief in jedem Chor” (Crooked in Every Choir). They announced their fifth studio album, “Sterben in Karl-Marx-Stadt,” for November 28, 2025, as well as the tour of the same name for 2026. Advance sales for the album and tour will start on Thursday, May 29, at 6:00 p.m. exclusively on kraftklub.to.

Stanley Stevenson-Byrne, better known as Fox Stevenson, has a knack for writing the soundtrack for your next adventure. He moves somewhere between a club-centric music producer and a singer-songwriter with heart. Working outside the boundaries of genres, he uses influences beyond dance music, often drawing on his pop-punk upbringing. The result is songs that bridge the gap between different musical styles and always embody the typical Fox sound - infectious, adventurous and always full of charisma.

Fox Stevenson's 2019 debut album Killjoy is the perfect introduction to the Englishman's unique world and marks a new chapter in his already unmissable career. In addition to Killjoy, which included the popular "Dreamland", "Go Like" and "Out My Head", 2019 also saw the birth of Fox Stevenson LIVE, a high-energy trio of drums, guitar and vocals that have taken their immersive live performances across the United States and Europe. "I love melodies, I love big drums, I love big bass and I love singing over it and that's the live band."

Over the past 15 years, Fox has released on Spinnin', Monstercat, Liquicity, Disciple, AntiFragile, UKF's Pilot-Imprint and many other labels, toured the world, earned the support of critics and peers, but most importantly, captured the hearts and imaginations of fans around the world.

Whose music is ingrained in its soul, Fox's sound is constantly evolving, each release is better than the last, and with no signs of slowing down, Fox Stevenson has much more in store.

ABOUT

With roots in Romania and Hungary, Abor & Tynna bring their wildly sparkling sound to the world from Vienna and produce most of their tracks in Berlin. Between clubby basslines, modern electro, and cheeky disco pop, the sibling duo moves effortlessly through the musical coordinates of Gen Z—energetic, direct, and instantly catchy.

Last year, Abor & Tynna caused a sensation across Europe with their ESC single “Baller.” The song went far beyond the competition to become one of the most successful German ESC titles in recent years: #3 on the German and Austrian singles charts, #1 in Latvia and Lithuania, over 60 million streams worldwide, and a steadily growing international fan base speak for themselves. Since the ESC, the duo's career has developed rapidly: hundreds of thousands of new followers on social media and millions of monthly listeners on streaming platforms.

With straightforward lyrics and their antidote of cool electro and naughty disco pop, the siblings take a bold approach to the algorithm that besieges Gen Z from all sides and ask questions that no one else dares to ask. “We see that many people feel lost – music gives us the opportunity to change our perspective: What lies behind what is left unsaid? What do we all really want and where does the pressure come from?”

They always felt a little different, because their home life was a little more traditional than others and a touch stricter. They had to be home earlier in the evening and their cell phones weren't always available—but they did have traditional instruments. What teenagers don't always find great is what defines Abor & Tynna today: their self-esteem comes from a more reliable source than pure external appearance and allows them the freedom they take for their music. “We celebrate what inspires us at the moment. When the vibes are right, we throw everything out the window in the studio because we'd rather not ignore a good feeling than stick to some theory.”

Live performances clearly demonstrate why the duo is currently one of the most exciting pop acts in the German-speaking world: powerful beats, immediate energy, and songs that oscillate between euphoria, melancholy, and club moments. In 2025, Abor & Tynna finally embarked on their first major “Bittersüß” headlining tour through Europe. Several dates were moved up due to high demand, Berlin sold out months in advance and received an additional show.

Noga Erez is a visionary musician and producer with an innate talent for blending genres and pushing creative boundaries. She along with her partner and producer Rousso have emerged as a trailblazing force in the contemporary music scene. Drawing inspiration from her surroundings and experiences, her music delves fearlessly into topics ranging from societal issues to personal introspection, all delivered with a raw, unapologetic honesty. Her unique sonic palette creates a mesmerizing fusion that defies conventional categorization. Noga's clever lyrics, coupled with her infectious melodies and powerful vocals, have earned her widespread acclaim and a dedicated global following. With a string of successful releases, Noga Erez has cemented her position as a boundary-pushing artist, consistently reinventing herself with each new project. Her live performances are known for their infectious energy and dynamic stage presence, captivating audiences and leaving a lasting impact on all who experience her music firsthand. As she continues to evolve and captivate the music world, Noga Erez remains an inspiring and influential figure, a true artistic force that is destined to shape the future of music.

Take one studio. Three young musicians. And endless potential. It all makes sense. At least when Ego, Schutt and Tom are working on new hits in their studio in Vienna. Under the stage name Glueboys, the Pinzgauer Buam perform throughout the German-speaking world. Whether reggae tunes, hard dance melodies or après-ski hits - the trio ensures a great party atmosphere at every event.

ABOUT

Twitch, YouTube, Instagram or TikTok - no matter where, Filow is already there. Within a year, he doubled the number of followers on his channels and became one of the most relevant German-speaking newcomers. Filow plays the social media game at the highest level, but is always reinventing himself. His content is like his humor: on the pulse of Generation Z, always on trend, always different, always funny.

Since 2022, the vegan musician has also been producing songs with a catchy tune guarantee that have found a permanent place in the Spotify playlists of many streamers.

ABOUT

By 2025, makko will definitely be one of the biggest stars that German rap has produced in the last year. A man of many trades with a deep voice flow, maximum coolness, urban sensitivity, and an unmistakable aesthetic somewhere between skate spot, studio, and Boloboys universe. The widest gap between his teeth in Berlin, his trademark style, and his inimitable switch heels have long made him a figure you recognize before you hear him.

Growing up between Brandenburg and Berlin, first came skateboarding, then music—a reversed Lil Wayne story that still forms his creative backbone today. Ever since “Nachts wach” (together with Miksu & Macloud), makko has been one of the scene's undisputed fixtures. He also released the “Undercover EP” with the two, which once again sharpened his cross-genre style and pushed musical boundaries. 

2025 was all about his breakthrough and coming of age:

over 500 million streams, a legendary Splash! performance with a capacity of 15,000 people, new creative alliances – including with Nina Cuba – that have further opened up and expanded his sound.

makko has long been more than just a rapper: he is a movement, a style, a feeling for a generation that lives nonconformity rather than performing it. An artist who has come to stay – and who will be bigger than ever in 2026.

ABOUT

Tom Odell has never lived up to the image people have of him. "My music was perceived as a 'major label creation'," says the singer-songwriter with an eye roll. In the early stages of his career, perhaps because he burst onto the scene armed with a Brits Critics' Choice Award, an instantly ubiquitous single ('Another Love') and a major label deal, critics questioned his authenticity - as if his knack for a good hook were somehow a taint against him. Even his last year's album 'Monsters' - on which he pushes boundaries, experiments with new sounds and talks about his struggles with crippling fears - has been dismissed by some as an attempt to stay relevant. "I don't care if people don't like my music, but when someone says, 'This is a major label creation,' I say, 'You have no idea how hard I worked on it,'" says Odell.

Also, no one seemed to know where to put him. "Alternative people think I'm pop, and pop people think I'm alternative..." So he decided he didn't want to please anyone anymore. He left Sony, released the outside pressure and made the record that felt right in his bones. "I feel so free, so liberated, to be an independent artist," he says. "Honestly, this music is a huge relief because I can do exactly what I want. I didn't want to throw in as many hooks as I could, not have the chorus right at the beginning of the song, but just create an environment for people to sit and breathe to the music."

ABOUT

CLOCKCLOCK will be unmissable in 2026: for the upcoming festival season, the hit trio led by Boki, which has become an absolute live magnet, has announced a huge wave of outdoor dates.

Before the summer events, the band will also set out to conquer Eastern Europe: In April 2026, five shows are on the agenda in Hungary, Croatia, Czechia, Poland, and Slovakia.

And for the “Dream Forever” tour in 2026, which starts in February, Munich, Hamburg, Cologne, and Berlin are already sold out, with Stuttgart and Hanover close behind—if that's not a reason to declare 2026 the year of CLOCKCLOCK.

It's crystal clear: CLOCKCLOCK's path will continue upward in 2026 – the chart-toppers are guaranteed hits and a rousing live act of international caliber. To experience the trio up close once again before they make the leap to the big venues, now is the time to secure tickets for 2026!

He is Sido. He is Paul. He is LIVE again and he is back in his element, with a new album, new hits and in good old SIDO style incl. powerful entertainment, the long-running hits, the well-known songs and his hymns.

In the summer of 2023, SIDO will be on the road again and play festivals in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

SIDO: FESTIVALS LIVE 2023.

SIDO is and remains a one-of-a-kind. No other German artist masters the balancing act between hip-hop and mainstream as well as the masked man. This is also reflected in his audience. After more than 20 years at the top, SIDO manages to unite the generations of his fans like hardly any other rapper in Germany - by now, the rap fans of the first hour are often in the audience together with their children.

Anyone who has ever experienced the exceptional artist SIDO in his live element knows that an energetic and unique show awaits him. Now you can look forward, get in the starting position and secure tickets for the festivals: https://bit.ly/3PySU5y

ABOUT

SSIO is back—and he wants it all or nothing. A decade as the king of rap is apparently not enough for him. With a new album (even before GTA VI), jewelry as golden as Donald Trump's hair, and Burberry velour joggers, the freshest Kabuli 2025 is returning to the stages of Germany, Austria, and Switzerland for his “First Tour After Corona” tour. 

Anyone who has seen SSIO live in the last ten years knows what to expect: a catalog crammed to the brim with head-nodding tracks from one of the country's most outrageous live rappers – or as SSIO says on his new single: “Your signing sees my live show and learns like an apprentice.” It's no coincidence that SSIO's live shows have always sold out in no time. So better get a move on!

It's a confidence that SSIO can certainly afford. Back in 2012, with his mixtape “Spezial Material,” he delivered a self-deprecating alternative to the clichéd street rap standard with late-nineties beats – and continued his triumphant success with albums such as “BB.UM.SS.N,” “0.9,” and “Messios”: three top ten entries and a few gold records included.

And for good reason. Because it is and remains difficult to find an artist who, like SSIO, manages to combine wordplay, personality, humor, authenticity, and exceptional rap skills into such a well-rounded package—and thus remain relevant despite all trends.

A glance at your trusted FYP is enough to see that SSIO is still a regular guest there—with mashups, remixes, or his own songs. Without any new releases or sounds designed to go viral, but with straight rap about selling narcotics, the advantages of working in adult entertainment, excessive fast food consumption, and traffic violations in very expensive sports cars – between Bonn-Tannenbusch and Bangkok.

ABOUT

Winners of the 2025 MOBO Award for Best Alternative Music Act, ALT BLK ERA are UK sister duo Nyrobi (21) and Chaya (18).

Their debut album Rave Immortal - a UK Rock & Metal No.1 - is a genre-smashing blend of Electronic sounds fused with Rock and DnB, proving their ability to bring underground club energy into alternative spaces.

As well as lighting up Spotify editorial playlists and UK radio, the sisters have also showcased their sound on major UK platforms, performing live on Later… with Jools Holland and Channel 4’s Sunday Brunch, cementing their reputation as one of the most exciting new forces in genre-fluid music.

BBC Introducing hailed them as Ones to Watch in 2025 before they represented the UK at SXSW, Texas showcasing at The British Music Embassy.

They have also delivered standout performances at iconic UK and EU festivals including Lowlands, Glastonbury, Reading & Leeds, and Download, where their raw energy leave audiences in no doubt that ALT BLK ERA are redefining what alternative, electronic and rock music can be.

Press acclaim has come from NME, REVOLVER and Kerrang!, with the Brit Awards calling their sound “break the repeat button.”

Beyond the music, the sisters advocate for hidden disability awareness and inclusivity in the industry, inspired by Nyrobi’s personal journey - a theme woven through Rave Immortal.

With a growing international profile, ALT BLK ERA are proving themselves as one of the most forward-thinking acts shaping the future of alternative sound.

ABOUT

The last few years have been a dizzying ascent for Denzel Curry. After establishing himself as one of the leaders of rap's new underground through early full-lengths like 2013's Nostalgic 64 and 2016's Imperial, the latter of which saw the Carol City, Florida native cosigned by Rick Ross and earn him a spot on XXL's coveted Freshman list, Curry spent the last six years releasing four concept-driven full-length albums that catapulted him from cult icon to one of the most celebrated names in rap. From the innovative, 3-part release strategy of 2018's TA13OO, which highlighted Curry's preternatural gift for melody in standout track "CLOUT COBAIN," to the diaristic 2019 album ZUU where he detailed parts of his life previously untold in a song like "RICKY ," and 2020's full-length collaboration UNLOCKED with superproducer Kenny Beats, Curry released a trio of critically-acclaimed albums that established him as one of the most vital voices in rap. With 2022's Melt My Eyez See Your Future, Curry demonstrated his ability to synthesize the lyrical prowess for which he's become known with the kind of earworm choruses of pop in songs like "Walkin" and "X-Wing."

Most recently, Zel released his new album King of the Mischievous South Vol. 2, the official sequel to the project – and revisiting the sound – that helped launch his career. While the project that features highlights like “HOT ONE” and ULTRA SHXT” marks a return to his roots, it also signals the arrival of a new era in Denzel’s career that sees him standing as a peer alongside the biggest names in the genre after more than a decade of critically-acclaimed releases. Known for his visceral live shows - both on stage and screen - whether it’s The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, Coachella, NPR’s Tiny Desk Concert, sold-out arena shows, or an On The Radar cypher; Denzel is an inimitable performer that continues to leave his mark on the music.

ABOUT

Summer 2024. A huge crowd stands in front of the stage, their impatient wait immediately turning into exuberant applause as Chino, Mateo, Johnny Strange, and Don Cali take the stage:

The world has changed a lot in the last 22 years. However, the boundless joy and unbroken energy at a Culcha Candela show has hardly changed at all!

With over five million records sold, almost 35 gold and platinum awards, and more than 1,500 live shows, Culcha Candela may not be reinventing themselves, but they don't need to.

Time and again in recent years, the Berlin cult collective has shown that they can shake energetic club bangers and hits with attitude out of their colorful sleeves with playful ease—today as in the past. After almost a quarter of a century in showbiz, the band continues to tour sold-out venues, has just delivered the theme song for the European Handball Championship in Germany (“Celebration”) and celebrated the 15th anniversary of the smash hit “MONSTA” in September 2024.

CULCHA CANDELA has come up with something very special for this occasion: With a whole box of great surprises, strong collaborations, and a brand-new MONSTA 15 EP, September was monstrously strong.

The guys recently showed that they're still up for a bit of fun when they posted a fun dance video on TikTok to Shirin David's song “Bauch Beine Po” and announced that they would release a new single if the clip got 1 million views. The following week, they promptly announced the release of their new single KILLAH (September 6). Of course, the 1 million views were quickly collected!

But that's not all: a huge indoor tour is on the schedule for March 2025. Standing still and pop star retirement are simply not (yet) options for the legendary hip-hop, reggae, and Latin band.

The four Berlin boys can rarely bear to watch the world go by as mere “onlookers.” Culcha Candela have always wanted to make a difference and make the world a little bit better. That's why they continue to be heavily involved in social projects such as BeAnAngel e.V., Die Arche, ActionKids, Laut Gegen Nazis, Pro Asyl, Seebrücke, Afrika Rise, and many others.

Originating from Hayes, West London. KiLLOWEN i s a rapper, producer and songwriter who has been making music since 13 years old.

With a unique blend o f U K Garage, rap and dance, KiLLOWEN has made a name for himself by releasing consistently, as well as collaborating with artists like p-rallel. Songer, SILK and Tommy Villiers.

KiLLOWEN has also built his fan base through some huge live performances such a s Reading & Leeds Festival, Parklife two performances at SXSW in Austin Texas and Sydney Australia, a s well a s being main support for Songer on his UK tour. With a stacked 2024 ahead of him, including an EP, a summer full of festivals, and a UK tour - KiLLOWEN shows n o signs of slowing down.

Ski Aggu is a phenomenon. Since landing a viral hit in October 2022 with the song “Party Sahne,” which has since been awarded a gold record, things have been moving at a rapid pace. He's a regular in Spotify's Top 50, has reached number 1 in the singles and album charts, and has sold out his tour. When his gabber pop reinterpretation of Otto Waalkes' “Friesenjung” also went viral on TikTok in the summer of 2023, it became clear just how strong Aggu's community is. They fought for the sample to be released; in the end, the comedy legend not only supported the promo and appeared in the music video, but also performed alongside Ski Aggu at Splash, Germany's largest hip-hop festival. No other artist encapsulates the Berlin lifestyle and the zeitgeist of Gen Z as authentically in their lyrics, music videos, and social media presence as Ski Aggu. The Wilmersdorf native enjoys life – especially when rapping, with punchlines, technique, laid-back flow, and entertaining, authentic West Berlin rap. But since his life isn't a constant party, he regularly reflects on his sometimes perhaps somewhat unrestrained lifestyle in his lyrics.

ABOUT

"I rapped for fun but don't release stuff - Adri told me to just do it," raps Berlin high-flyer Ski Aggu. Who is this Adri that Aggu keeps mentioning?

Adrian Julius Tillmann first made a name for himself in Berlin's creative scene as an actor. Among other things, he starred in the Netflix series "Biohackers." In 2020, after encouraging his best friend Ski Aggu to release music with great success, he finally took the plunge himself in 2023: with the release of his debut single "Einsame Insel," the musician Ritter Lean was born.

The fact that Ritter Lean comes from film is not only noticeable in his image-rich videos, but also in his largely self-produced music. His lively storytelling could not be more captivating. Thus Ritter Lean tells true-to-life stories of lost souls in the techno capital, of never-ending evenings in dirty bars and his constant tendency towards extremes. He tries to hide his big ego just as little as his vulnerability. For his stories he finds a language unprecedented in German indie pop: dirty and rough, but honest and unafraid to provoke.

Hailed by Rolling Stone as “A Viral Pioneer”, bbno$ is no stranger to producing addictive hooks, having released the first ever TikTok thit, ‘Lalala’ with Y2K in 2019, which has gone 10x Platinum across the globe. Unlike a lot of his counterparts who's fame stemmed from a "TikTok hit", bbno$'s fame was no "flash in the pan" and his artistry quickly came to be respected in 2021 when he recreated his virality with his next hyper-successful hit "Edamame" which has gone 8x Platinum globally. He had opportunities flow in from his success with a performance at the JUNO’s, guest appearance during Coachella, a Late Night TV performance on Jimmy Kimmel, amongst many others. Over the years, bbno$ has become a case study in how to succeed as an independent artist. The sheer success accumulated by the young artist is evidenced by the fact that he has been featured in Billboard, Flaunt, tmrw, Rolling Stone, NME, Lady Gunn, SPIN, Euphoria, i-D, Ones to Watch and many other publications. His work as an artist and songwriter has received praise and support from the likes of both Capital FM and BBC R1’s Jack Saunders, and Triple J. In 2023 bbno$ released his 3rd album with Yung Gravy, Baby Gravy 3 and immediately went on to sell 3-5K cap rooms on the Baby Gravy tour across North

“I just feel like that’s the story of my life,” says Ken Carson, the wildly inventive, vocally adaptive rapper who has emerged as one of hip-hop’s can’t-miss breakout stars of the 2020s. He’s talking about his forthcoming album, A Great Chaos, the title of which captures the whirlwind that his existence has become—and the joy he takes in navigating that whirlwind with preternatural ease. “Shit be good,” he says, hesitating just before he adds the crucial caveat: “But life be life-ing.” That unpredictability, that sense that there’s always a complication around the corner, can be daunting. But it’s molded Carson into the artist he is today, ready to switch everything up at a moment’s notice. 

Born Kenyatta Frazier Jr. in the spring of 2000 and raised in Atlanta, Carson is living proof of another maxim: that steel sharpens steel. That was his experience growing up around his uncle, the celebrated producer TM88, and the cadre of rappers who worked closely with him. “I was the youngest in every room that I went into,” Carson recalls. Observing the work habits of superstars like Young Thug and Playboi Carti inspired Carson to push himself, and to be unsparing about sifting through the demos he recorded to find the best material. Finally, the results were undeniable: “I was playing one of my songs around the house,” Carson says, “and TM88 was like, ‘Who the hell is that?’ I said, ‘This is me!’”

From the time he and his friends began putting together their earliest songs in middle school, Carson had been rapping off the top of his head, rather than scrawling his thoughts in notebooks. But this process, he explains, actually allowed him to dig deeper into his psyche. “I’m always surprised,” he says of the topics and thematic concerns that recur in his spur-of-the-moment takes. That surprise becomes a sort of electric excitement when those takes coalesce into a truly unique record. “I’m four or five thousand songs deep,” he notes, “and I still surprise myself—I still get the same feeling as when I made my first good song.” 

When Carson was still a teenager, he inked a deal with Carti’s Opium imprint and began distilling his buoyant energy into the EPs that would introduce him to the world at large: Boy Barbie and Teen X, released in the spring and summer of 2020 respectively. The pandemic had forced clubs and house parties—the natural ecosystems for many of Carson’s songs—to shutter. But rather than be discouraged, the artist saw the vacation of his lane as an opportunity. “It was actually so, so, so much easier” to break through during this fraught period, he figures, “because I felt like I was the only one outside. All these established artists couldn’t do shit, and I could do anything.”

Moving swiftly continued to serve Carson well. By the end of 2021, he had released two more EPs (Lost Files and Teen X: Relapsed), a mixtape (Lost Files 2), and a debut album, Project X, which captured the unique alchemy of poise and urgency that makes his music unforgettable. That’s perhaps best evidenced by the project’s breakout hit, “Rock N Roll,” where chaos seems to simmer just under a convincingly casual surface. On other standout songs, like Teen X’s “Yale,” this effect is even leveraged to communicate a kind of ennui, Carson sounding weary and regretful before his time. 

But no project to date has synthesized all the things that make Ken Carson special like A Great Chaos. “I was a student for a long time,” he says of the road that led him here. “I used to really, really, really study—I’d go home and watch interviews. In order to make it with this music shit, you gotta bring something new to the table. If you wanna be great, you gotta do something that’s gonna stand out.” And that’s exactly what he’s done with his third official LP, a fever dream of emotional pain and consumer excess, each complicating the other, blurring its origin points. Whether on the sly single “Jennifer’s Body” or the stark “Hardcore,” Carson confirms himself as a slick, athletic vocalist who can contort himself into any shape necessary to chase a song’s ideal form. “I’ve never been on vacation,” he says. “I’ve never taken a break in four years.” The dedication is paying off in ways he could have only imagined.

ASHNIKKO makes music for the girls in the club with their heels in their hands, mascara running down their cheeks as they screech “This is my song!” and scurry to the dancefloor. The perfect antidote for coy pop sexuality in 2019, she’d rather reject the cautious euphemisms and tell a crowd of people to eat her pussy without shame. Her upbringing might have been hampered by her parent’s Bible-thumping heritage, but her mother’s liberal approach to sexuality means she knew it was never shameful to talk about or explore her own body. That’s an imperative part of the ASHNIKKO manifesto: that no woman has the responsibility to shrink herself or shy away from her brilliance at the hands of patriarchal power.

Grammy-Award winning band, Twenty One Pilots, have shifted music and culture as an incomparable creative force and with an ever-evolving vision. The Columbus, OH duo—Tyler Joseph and Josh Dun— have tallied over 33 billion global streams and counting, sold north of three million tickets worldwide, notched dozens of multi-Platinum certifications, and even claimed a spot in the Guinness® Book of World Records. In historic fashion, their quadruple-Platinum breakout LP, Blurryface, took flight as “the first album to notch a RIAA Gold or Platinum certification for every one of its songs, while Vessel followed suit and achieved the same distinction. They elevated to rarified air as “one of only 18 artists to earn multiple RIAA Diamond certifications,” going Diamond with “Stressed Out” and “Heathens.” 2018’s Platinum-certified Trench extended the ambitious concept laid out in Blurryface and delivered the multi-Platinum and Platinum singles: “Chlorine,” “My Blood” and the GRAMMY® Award-nominated “Jumpsuit.” They followed Trench with their Gold-certified LP Scaled And Icy, achieving “the biggest opening week for a rock album in 2021” by capturing #1 on the Billboard Top Rock Albums and Top Alternative Albums charts and crashing the Top 3 of the Billboard 200. Beyond rapturous headline shows at arenas and festivals worldwide, Twenty One Pilots have notably architected an immersive world without comparison, originating a multi-album conceptual arc across Blurryface, Trench and Scaled And Icy.

In 2024, the band released their seventh full-length offering, Clancy [Fueled By Ramen], which shattered records as the biggest rock debut AND biggest rock album overall of 2024. Led by the single “Overcompensate,” the LP signals the dawn of another era for Twenty One Pilots and alternative rock music at large. The band closed out the year with “The Line,” an original track for Netflix’s Arcane Season 2 that has already seen massive growth on streaming platforms. Just weeks after wrapping their massive Clancy World Tour, Twenty One Pilots announced their latest record, Breach, which marks the long-awaited conclusion to the story first introduced a decade ago on Blurryface. The first single off the record, “The Contract,” marked the biggest song debut of the band’s career and reached #1 on the Alternative Airplay chart, their 12th time accomplishing this feat. Following the album’s release on September 12, the band kicks off THE CLANCY TOUR: BREACH 2025, which will hit stadiums and amphitheatres across North America, closing with two nights at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles.

For over 15 years, Mandidextrous has been an instrumental figure in the UK/European underground music industry. With their unique and high-energy productions, they have captivated audiences, packing out clubs and festival dance floors wherever they go. Their seamless fusion of D&B and Techno, combined with influences from various dance genres and nostalgic rave sounds, sets them apart as a true innovator and skilled producer .

Mandidextrous, who prefers they/them pronouns, identifies as Trans Non-Binary and has become an inspiring beacon of representation for queer culture and trans lives in the dance music community.

Alongside their musical talent, they have established a significant social media presence and earned support from renowned platforms such as Radio One, BBC Introducing, and UKF. 2023 was subject to an momentous rise in M’s career picking up a prestigious award from Drum & Bass arena that was voted for by many industry professionals as the Critics Choice. This has helped

Mandidextrous solidify their involvement within the D&B Industry and community. Their music, both infamous and sought after , has earned the admiration of many DJs and prominent labels. Notably, they've made significant strides with Ram Records and their new imprint Program, leaving a lasting legacy within the European hard techno scene and the UK/European D&B scene.

An impressive 11 years of running their successful label, Amen4T ekno Records, and organizing sell-out events under their brand Kiss My Kick Drums has created a thriving movement in the music scene. Through their label, events, and music, they have influenced the European hard techno scene and the UK/European D&B scene.

Mandidextrous's achievements extend beyond their musical prowess. They've held key positions with prominent festivals, notably serving as a music creator for Boomtown Fair , crafting the music for the infamous closing ceremonies for two consecutive years. Additionally, they've curated exceptional underground music stages, including The Scrapyard and the recently acclaimed Spectrum 360. Their pinnacle sets at events like Let It Roll, Glastonbury, and Bassizm have further solidified their reputation as an exceptional performer .

Even with a remarkable track record in the industry, Mandidextrous shows no signs of slowing down. Their dedication to pushing creative boundaries and their projects' consistent success has established them as an industry powerhouse, spreading positivity, love, and equality wherever they go.
